mount_point.description: FUSE mount point for the protected filesystem

cache_ttl.description: Cache TTL in seconds (0 disables caching)

cache_size.description: Maximum number of entries in scan cache

email_alert.description: Whether to send email notifications on virus detection

email_to.description: Recipient email address for virus alerts

smtp_server.description: SMTP server host for sending alerts

exclude_patterns.description: List of regex patterns to exclude from scanning

log_file.description: Path to log file; empty string logs to stderr
